claims.claim: Consolidated Alphabet revenues increased 24% to $119.8 billion.
Revenue growth was 23% in constant currency.
The quarter marked Alphabet's 12th consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth.
Google Services revenues rose 15% to $94.5 billion.
Google Search & other grew 17%.
Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices grew 15%.
YouTube ads grew 13%.
Google Cloud revenues accelerated significantly, increasing 82% to $24.8 billion.
Google Cloud growth was driven by demand for enterprise AI Solutions and infrastructure.
Consolidated Alphabet operating income increased 30%.
Operating margin expanded two percentage points to 34%.
Net income available to common stockholders surged 298%.
Diluted EPS reached $9.11.
The increase was largely due to a net gain of $98.0 billion from unrealized gains on equity securities.
Google Cloud growth was led by increases in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across enterprise AI Solutions and enterprise AI Infrastructure, alongside core GCP services.
Search query growth is being driven by popular AI features.
The Gemini App has 950 million monthly active users.
Gemini models process 22 billion API tokens per minute.
Over 1.7 billion unique viewers watched World Cup-related videos on YouTube during the FIFA World Cup 2026.
Nearly 90% of the Fortune 100 are using Gemini Enterprise.
The release does not provide specific numerical guidance for future quarters or full-year revenue targets.
Management stated they have exciting momentum across the board.
Management did not offer quantitative projections for upcoming periods.
No explicit outlook regarding capital expenditure plans beyond general corporate purposes was provided in the release.

In June 2026 Alphabet issued a combination of Class A stock, Class C stock, and mandatory convertible preferred stock generating aggregate net proceeds of $49.6 billion for general corporate purposes.
Alphabet entered into an equity distribution agreement to sell up to $40.0 billion of Class A and Class C stock through an At-the-Market Program.
No shares had been sold under the ATM Program as of June 30, 2026.
Senior unsecured notes were issued in the second quarter of 2026 for net proceeds of $20.3 billion, to be used for general corporate purposes.
The release states that fluctuations in the value of investments may be affected by market dynamics and could significantly contribute to the volatility of other income and expense in future periods.
Proceeds from the equity issuance are intended for capital expenditures to scale AI infrastructure and global compute.
The release indicates that certain costs related to shared AI research and development, corporate initiatives, and fines are not allocated to segments.
